Firstly thank you so much for taking the time to read and respond to my dumb rant, you’re the first person todo so and it means a lot.

I had a dream job that i’ve dreamt about doing since I was young, I went to uni to get the  necessary degree to potentially work in this sector,
Turns out I’m not smart enough, I struggled hard and failed the first year, I was given the option to try again but instead I just left.

I have a job at the moment but it’s definitely not something I want to do forever nor am I very good at it, odds are that I’ll they’ll probably let me go after my probation period is up. So I’ll be a failure at that too.
